description: Translate text between languages using a LibreTranslate instance you supply — pass _apiKey for libretranslate.com or _endpoint for a self-hosted server. For translation with no key of your own, deepl_translate covers the same languages.

source.description: Source language code (e.g. "en" for English, "es" for Spanish)

target.description: Target language code (e.g. "es" for Spanish, "fr" for French)

name: translate

original_text.description: The original text that was translated

title: Translate
